task: Implement the approved eleven-phase lossless repository cleanup plan while preserving every dot directory and virtual environment as opaque keep zones.
instructions: Replace every pending status with apply plus decision and evidence, or skip plus reason. Keep names and structure unchanged.

methods.name: diagnosing-bugs
methods.reason: This is a planned migration, not a reported defect. Activate it only if a baseline failure exposes a separate bug.

methods.name: domain-modeling
methods.decision: Use one liveness registry and one authority lifecycle model for every file disposition.

methods.name: how
methods.decision: Trace each live subsystem, command, verifier, and data path before changing it.

methods.name: why
methods.reason: The approved plan records the relevant rationale. Direct liveness evidence decides implementation.

methods.name: architect
methods.decision: Design replay, analysis, corpus, registry, and test-dispatch interfaces before editing production code.

methods.name: arena
methods.decision: Compare distinct interface sketches for each one-way module redesign.

methods.name: codebase-design
methods.decision: Judge changed modules by depth, locality, seam placement, and the deletion test.

methods.name: tdd
methods.reason: Implement-flow selects pocock-tdd. Unqualified Pstack TDD does not own this route.

methods.name: pocock-tdd
methods.decision: Use red-green slices at the approved cleanup CLI, registry, dispatcher, replay, corpus, and root seams.

methods.name: implement
methods.decision: Implement the approved eleven-phase cleanup and run narrow checks plus the final suite.

methods.name: code-review
methods.decision: Review the final diff against standards and the approved cleanup plan as separate axes.

pstack_principles.name: principle-boundary-discipline
pstack_principles.decision: Validate manifests, CLI input, paths, hashes, and recovery only at their owning seams.

pstack_principles.name: principle-build-the-lever
pstack_principles.decision: Build one dry-run cleanup command and verifier instead of editing the repository by hand.

pstack_principles.name: principle-encode-lessons-in-structure
pstack_principles.decision: Replace repeated file laws with registry validation, denial checks, and the test dispatcher.

pstack_principles.name: principle-exhaust-the-design-space
pstack_principles.decision: Use architect and arena before accepting replay, analysis, or corpus interface changes.

pstack_principles.name: principle-experience-first
pstack_principles.decision: Leave the next agent one START_HERE path and the maintainer one owner per fact.

pstack_principles.name: principle-fix-root-causes
pstack_principles.reason: No defect is under diagnosis at route entry. Apply it if a verification unit enters a debugging loop.

pstack_principles.name: principle-foundational-thinking
pstack_principles.decision: Land protection, liveness shapes, and complete verification before deletion.

pstack_principles.name: principle-guard-the-context-window
pstack_principles.decision: Work phase by phase and delegate bounded, disjoint tasks.

pstack_principles.name: principle-laziness-protocol
pstack_principles.decision: Prefer proven deletion, consolidation, and existing interfaces over new layers.

pstack_principles.name: principle-make-operations-idempotent
pstack_principles.decision: Make audit, move, deduplicate, and delete operations dry-runnable and convergent.

pstack_principles.name: principle-migrate-callers-then-delete-legacy-apis
pstack_principles.decision: Move every caller, test, build rule, and pointer with each removed path or interface.

pstack_principles.name: principle-minimize-reader-load
pstack_principles.decision: Contract the root, remove pass-throughs, and give every fact one canonical home.

pstack_principles.name: principle-model-the-domain
pstack_principles.decision: Encode liveness, semantic role, recovery, action, and state in typed registry rows.

pstack_principles.name: principle-never-block-on-the-human
pstack_principles.decision: Proceed with reversible verified work and pause only before an unmanifested delete or external write.

pstack_principles.name: principle-outcome-oriented-execution
pstack_principles.decision: Converge on the target tree without permanent redirects, dual interfaces, or an archive root.

pstack_principles.name: principle-prove-it-works
pstack_principles.decision: Bind every destructive unit to a recovery, rebuild, identity, or semantic oracle.

pstack_principles.name: principle-redesign-from-first-principles
pstack_principles.decision: Separate current state, stable rules, chronology, machine authority, data, and evidence.

pstack_principles.name: principle-separate-before-serializing-shared-state
pstack_principles.decision: Give workers disjoint write ownership and keep destructive phases under one registry writer.

pstack_principles.name: principle-sequence-verifiable-units
pstack_principles.decision: Execute eleven ordered phases and keep every completed unit green.

pstack_principles.name: principle-subtract-before-you-add
pstack_principles.decision: Remove proven safe waste before path moves, module reshaping, and documentation polish.

pstack_principles.name: principle-type-system-discipline
pstack_principles.decision: Use enums and typed rows for liveness states, actions, recovery classes, and interfaces.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-codebase-glossary
supplemental_principles.decision: Use module, interface, seam, adapter, depth, leverage, and locality consistently.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-codebase-depth
supplemental_principles.decision: Keep replay, analysis, corpus, and dispatch interfaces smaller than hidden knowledge.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-codebase-principles
supplemental_principles.decision: Apply the deletion test and real-adapter rule before keeping an abstraction.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-codebase-testability
supplemental_principles.decision: Accept dependencies and test behavior through each module interface.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-codebase-relationships
supplemental_principles.decision: Place interfaces at seams that concentrate changing knowledge.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-codebase-rejected-framings
supplemental_principles.decision: Reject line-count depth, transport-type interfaces, and overloaded boundary terminology.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-codebase-going-deeper
supplemental_principles.decision: Classify dependencies and replace shallow tests with interface tests.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-deepening-dependencies
supplemental_principles.decision: Classify redesigned dependencies before choosing adapters.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-deepening-seams
supplemental_principles.decision: Expose seams only when real production and test implementations justify them.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-deepening-tests
supplemental_principles.decision: Delete retired internal tests after replacement interface tests pass.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-design-it-twice
supplemental_principles.decision: Compare at least two distinct interfaces for each deepening candidate.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-tdd-good-tests
supplemental_principles.decision: Write behavior tests through public interfaces with independent expected values.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-tdd-seams
supplemental_principles.decision: Test the approved cleanup CLI, registry, dispatcher, replay, corpus, and root seams.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-tdd-antipatterns
supplemental_principles.decision: Reject private tests, internal mocks, tautologies, and horizontal test batches.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-tdd-loop
supplemental_principles.decision: Run one failing behavior test, one minimal implementation, and one green proof per slice.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-test-quality
supplemental_principles.decision: Keep expected values independent and tests stable across internal refactors.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-mocking-boundaries
supplemental_principles.decision: Use named fakes only for filesystem, recovery, time, and true external seams.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-writing-context
supplemental_principles.decision: Use sharp START_HERE pointers and keep branch facts out of always-loaded prose.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-writing-loads
supplemental_principles.decision: Reduce agent context load and maintainer document-choice load.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-writing-hierarchy
supplemental_principles.decision: Keep current steps, stable rules, chronology, and exact authority in separate owners.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-writing-completion
supplemental_principles.decision: Give each retained agent document a checkable purpose and deletion criterion.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-writing-split
supplemental_principles.decision: Split reference only when a real branch earns a pointer.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-writing-leading-words
supplemental_principles.decision: Use liveness, authority, recovery, and chronology as stable terms.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-writing-pruning
supplemental_principles.decision: Delete cached facts, duplicate meaning, stale branches, and no-op instructions.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-implementation-checks
supplemental_principles.decision: Run narrow tests throughout and the complete registry at the end.

supplemental_principles.name: akita-code-style
supplemental_principles.decision: Keep touched functions focused, files below 500 lines, names specific, and types explicit.

supplemental_principles.name: akita-comments
supplemental_principles.decision: Preserve intent comments and remove narration introduced by this work.

supplemental_principles.name: akita-tests
supplemental_principles.decision: Give new behavior independent tests and keep one complete project command.

supplemental_principles.name: akita-dependencies
supplemental_principles.decision: Inject external dependencies and hide third-party details behind owned interfaces.

supplemental_principles.name: akita-structure
supplemental_principles.decision: Use predictable paths and split modules by owned knowledge.

supplemental_principles.name: akita-formatting
supplemental_principles.decision: Run each language default formatter over touched production files.

supplemental_principles.name: akita-logging
supplemental_principles.decision: Keep diagnostic logs structured and CLI output plain.

foundations.name: codebase-design
foundations.decision: Use deep-module design for every interface-changing phase.

foundations.name: diagnosing-bugs
foundations.reason: The work starts as a planned migration, not defect diagnosis.

foundations.name: domain-modeling
foundations.decision: Use liveness and authority models for every disposition.
